# CHOIVE
# https://choive.com/llms.txt

CHOIVE is a diagnostic system that shows why a business 
is not being recommended by AI — and what to fix.

---

## THE CORE PROBLEM

When someone asks ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, or Gemini 
to recommend a business, the AI picks one answer. 
Most businesses never get picked.

This is not always because the business is bad.
It is because the AI cannot find enough clear, verified 
information about the business to trust it.

CHOIVE finds out exactly why. It checks what each AI 
system sees when asked about a business. It scores what 
is working and what is missing. It names who is winning 
instead. It delivers the specific changes and ready-to-use 
files needed to fix it.

---

## WHAT CHOIVE IS NOT

CHOIVE is not a marketing agency.
CHOIVE is not an SEO tool.
CHOIVE is not a consulting service.
CHOIVE is not a ranking tool.

It is a diagnostic system.
It explains what is true, why it is true, 
and what must change.

---

## HOW IT WORKS — THREE LEVELS

### Level 1: Free Diagnostic

Anyone can run a free diagnostic at choive.com.
No account needed. Takes about 45 seconds.

The business enters: name, category, location, website, 
and where people can choose them.

CHOIVE asks Claude, ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini 
the same question a real buyer would ask.
It records each answer through the official AI provider 
systems — not the consumer apps.
It shows whether the business appeared in the answer 
or whether a competitor appeared instead.
It gives a CHOIVE Score and a short breakdown.

The free result shows the score, the top competitor 
AI recommended, and a summary of what is missing.

### Level 2: Full Analysis (paid)

The full analysis goes deeper on every finding.
It shows the complete evidence behind each score.
It names the exact competitors AI recommended, 
at which position, in which recorded query.
It explains in plain language why each finding 
happened — not just what the finding is.
It delivers five ready-to-use files.
It provides a 30/60/90 day roadmap broken 
down week by week with completion checks.

### Level 3: CHOIVE Report

A complete branded PDF version of the full analysis.
Designed to share with a team, agency, or board.

---

## THE CHOIVE SCORE

The CHOIVE Score is a number out of 100.
It measures four things:

CLARITY (out of 25)
Is it immediately clear what the business does, 
who it serves, and where?
A clear business is easy for AI to describe accurately.

TRUST (out of 25)
Has anyone outside the business confirmed it is good?
This includes reviews with visible review counts, 
press mentions, named client outcomes, 
and third-party citations AI can verify.
Without independent proof, AI will not name 
a business when a buyer is deciding.

DIFFERENCE (out of 25)
Is there a clear, specific reason to choose this 
business over the next one?
Not a claim. A verifiable fact.
Transaction volume. Years of operation. 
A named specialism. A measurable outcome.

EASE (out of 25)
Can AI systems actually read, index, 
and reference the website?
This includes: schema markup, llms.txt presence, 
meta descriptions, page structure, and whether 
any AI crawlers are blocked in robots.txt.

---

## WHAT THE FULL ANALYSIS RESULT CONTAINS

### The Verdict
The score. The score change since the last run. 
The benchmark: businesses that appear consistently 
in AI answers score above 62 across all four pillars. 
One sentence stating what is true right now.

### The Competition
The head-to-head competitor AI named instead — 
with the exact position it appeared in each 
recorded query (position 1, 3, 5, etc.).
The market competitor that matched all 
five comparison tests.
A side-by-side pillar comparison showing 
exactly where the gap is largest.

### What AI Actually Said
The 12 recorded AI answers across Claude, ChatGPT, 
Perplexity, and Gemini.
The exact question asked each time.
Whether the business appeared or not.
Who appeared instead.

### Why This Is Happening
The evidence behind each pillar score.
Each finding is a fact found during the diagnostic run — 
not an estimate or an opinion.
Examples: no press mention found in search evidence, 
Google review count not confirmed, Google-Extended 
blocked in robots.txt preventing Gemini from indexing.

### Ready-To-Use Assets
Five files written specifically for this business 
based on the diagnostic findings:

llms.txt — a structured file for AI systems to read, 
ready to upload to the website root.

H1 options — three rewritten homepage headline options 
that name the offer and the buyer without unsupported 
claims.

Meta description — one version ready to paste into 
website SEO settings.

Schema markup — JSON-LD structured data ready 
for a developer to validate and publish.

Customer evidence template — the exact format 
to publish client proof that AI systems can read 
and reference independently.

### Priority Actions
Labeled QUICK WIN, CRITICAL, or MEDIUM.
Each action states: what to do, why it matters, 
and how to verify it is complete.
Quick wins are actions that can be done in minutes 
with no developer and no cost.

### 30/60/90 Day Roadmap
Week-by-week sequence.
Each task labeled: YOU CAN DO THIS 
or FORWARD TO DEVELOPER.
Each task has a completion check — 
a specific, observable outcome that confirms the task is done.

### What AI Would Say After Changes
A simulated AI response showing what ChatGPT or Claude 
would say about the business once the priority 
actions are completed. This is what the business 
is working toward.

### Technical Evidence
Platform measurement ledger showing coverage 
across 4 platforms and 4 pillars.
Report confidence level.
Method and limitations.

---

## KEY TERMS

CHOIVE Score: the business's total score out of 100 
across Clarity, Trust, Difference, and Ease.

Selection gap: the difference between what 
the business gives AI to work with 
and what AI needs to recommend it.

Head-to-head competitor: the specific business 
AI named instead when asked about this business 
and its exact category in its exact market.

Market competitor: the business that matched 
all five category comparison tests — 
same product type, same buyer tier, 
same business model, same geography.

Quick win: an action that takes less than 
10 minutes, requires no developer, 
and produces a measurable result.

llms.txt: a structured text file placed at 
the root of a website that tells AI systems 
the verified facts about a business — 
what it does, who it serves, 
and what evidence supports it.

---

## WHO CHOIVE IS FOR

Businesses that are good but not getting enough clients.
Businesses where competitors seem to be winning 
without a clear reason why.
Businesses that have never checked what AI says 
about them — or what AI says instead of them.
Businesses where one missed client recommendation 
costs more than the diagnostic.

---

## ONE SENTENCE

CHOIVE shows why AI does not recommend your business 
and gives you exactly what is needed to change that.
